gates.title: JDK 25 required for Ghidra 12.3 DEV
gates.fix: Install JDK 25 EA (Temurin or Oracle). Ghidra 12.3 DEV will not start on JDK 17 or 21 — the analyzeHeadless script checks JAVA_HOME version and exits with "Unsupported JDK" if < 25.

gates.title: JAVA_HOME must point to JDK 25 installation
gates.fix: Export JAVA_HOME=/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/temurin-25.jdk/Contents/Home before running Ghidra. Shell profiles may override — verify with `java -version` in the same shell.

gates.title: radare2 dylib linking fails on ARM macOS
gates.fix: Build radare2 from source with `sys/install.sh` instead of Homebrew. The Homebrew bottle links against x86_64 dylibs on some mixed-arch systems. Verify with `file $(which r2)` showing arm64.

gates.title: rea-agents npm install fails on native modules
gates.fix: The rea-agents orchestrator (5,810 TS files) has native deps that require node-gyp + Python + make. On macOS ARM, ensure Xcode CLT is installed: `xcode-select --install`. Some deps need `npm rebuild` after arch switch.
